verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server plus tool calling/reasoning parsers, which is exactly the interface coding agents (Cursor, Continue, etc.) use to plug in a custom inference backend, and community comments confirm real-world use of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit named coding-agent integration examples (e.g., Cursor/Continue/Copilot pointed at vLLM) and independent hands-on verification of tool-calling reliability with an actual agent.
